t: Reyke Smart Tag Bluetooth luggage trackers: Are they worth it? | CNN Underscored
s: April 10, 2025 - Hundreds of people are buying this thing every month, so it’s gotta be good… right? Well, after purchasing one for myself, the answer is yes and no. There’s a lot to like about these affordable dupes. They offer nearly all of the same tracking features that AirTags do, and even have one neat advantage over Apple’s more expensive tags. However, after testing out Reyke’s tags for a week, it’s clear that some major corners were cut to reach this low price.
